opening: excellent. I'll turn the speakers up.
note: Decision 88: the door runs on the labels (the labels file in Matinee's state directory). One question, its kinds, then "anything". A film sits under every kind it is labelled with, at most two; a film not yet labelled waits behind the door under "anything" and "Just pick one!" only. A kind under 30 films in the library is not offered.

questions.ask: so, what kind of mayhem are we after?

options.say: superheroes. capes, powers, and comic-book heroics.
options.reply: of course. cue the superhero landing.

options.say: martial arts. fists, feet, and blades do the talking.
options.reply: very good. push the furniture back.

options.say: one against an army. someone picked the wrong fight.
spies and secret agents. gadgets, disguises, and a lot of running.
robots, space wars, and broken futures.
options.reply: excellent. the future's on fire again.

options.say: quests, treasure, and pirates. take me somewhere far away.
options.reply: pack light. we're not coming back for anything.

options.say: disaster and survival. nature, catastrophe, or stranded with no help coming.
war, on the front line. the battle, up close.
action comedies. big explosions, bigger mouths.
options.reply: lovely. expect one-liners at terrible moments.

superheroes.note: shared with the scifi and fantasy and animation doors, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

spies.note: shared with the thriller door, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

war_battle.note: shared with the war door, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.

action_comedy.note: shared with the comedy door, so a film behind both holds it at both or neither.
